description: Shared cross-repo test vector for the till-user PIN seal (reference/till-user-directives.md §2). ut-cloud seals deterministically with the fixed ephemeral key and must reproduce every value below; universal-till opens pin_sealed with the fixed recipient key and must get the PIN. Suite: RFC 9180 HPKE mode_base, DHKEM(X25519, HKDF-SHA256) / HKDF-SHA256 / AES-128-GCM, single-shot (sequence 0). Byte values are lowercase hex; info and aad are exact UTF-8 strings (aad fields joined by a single \n); kid is the first 16 hex chars of SHA-256 over the 32 raw recipient public-key bytes; pin_sealed is v1.<kid>.<base64url(enc)>.<base64url(ciphertext)> without padding. Test keys only.
